title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
About San Francisco Compute

San Francisco Compute (SFC) exists to give ambitious teams large scale supercomputers without taking on a catastrophic balance sheet risk. We are building the next generation of AI infrastructure, making large-scale GPU computing more accessible, flexible, and financially sustainable.

Unlike traditional GPU cloud providers, SFC combines supercomputer development and operations with an innovative compute marketplace, giving customers the flexibility to scale without the risks of rigid, long-term contracts.

We are a fast-growing team of ambitious, technically driven people working to shape the future of AI infrastructure. Our leadership team brings deep experience from Lambda, Crusoe, AWS, DigitalOcean, Hut 8, and Voltage Park, with a track record of deploying 8GW of data center capacity and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

There has never been a more critical moment in history, and it is up to us to shape it on behalf of those who come after us. If you're excited by complex challenges, bold ideas, and meaningful impact, we'd love to meet you.

About The Role

We're looking to hire a product engineer who ships end-to-end: someone who understands our customers, decides what's worth building, and takes it from rough idea to polished, production-ready experience. You care about quality and craft, but you're just as energized by figuring out what to build and why. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and design to ship features that move the business forward, and you'll have real ownership over the problems you take on.

What You Will Do

Own features and product areas end-to-end, from understanding the customer problem through shipping and iterating
Partner closely with product and design to turn rough ideas into shippable, delightful experiences
Build high-quality interfaces with attention to interaction, visual detail, and performance under real usage
Work across the stack where needed to deliver the full experience, not just the UI layer
Use customer feedback, usage data, and business context to decide what to build next and what to cut
Make sound technical decisions that scale with the product, and raise the bar for quality on the team

Who You Are

You have 8+ years experience in Engineering
You think in terms of customer problems and business outcomes, not just tickets
You've shipped meaningful product features end-to-end and can describe the impact they had
You have strong opinions about product quality and can point to specific things you'd fix in products you use every day
You're comfortable moving between frontend and backend to get something shipped
You have solid expertise in a modern JS framework (React, Vue, Svelte, or SolidJS) and are comfortable in a typed backend language
You have good product judgment and can make sensible tradeoffs with limited direction, and you know when to ask for help
You care about craft: your work is functional and also genuinely good

Nice To Have

Startup or early-stage experience where you wore a product-thinking hat alongside an engineering one
Experience shipping to external customers and connecting that work to business goals
Experience in developer tools, infrastructure, or technically-dense product spaces
Strong frontend craft in areas like motion, real-time data, or complex interactions

Benefits

Generous equity grant

Team members are offered a competitive salary along with equity in the company

Retirement matching

We match 401(k) plans up to 4%

Medical, dental & vision

We offer highly competitive medical, dental, vision insurance for employees and dependents.

Time off

We offer unlimited paid time off as well as 10+ observed holidays

Parental leave

We offer biological, adoptive, and foster parents paid time off to spend quality time with family

Daily lunch

We cover lunch daily for employees

Unlimited office book budget

You can buy as many books for the office as you want

The San Francisco Compute Company is committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

We make employment decisions based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, belief, national origin, social or ethical origin, age, physical, mental, or sensory disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, HIV status, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status including pregnancy, or any other status protected by law.

We welcome the opportunity to consider qualified applicants with prior arrest or conviction records. Our commitment to diversity includes hiring talented individuals regardless of their criminal history, in accordance with local, state, and federal laws, including San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance and California’s ban-the-box laws.
